{{Short description|German mathematician (1586–1628)}}
[[File:Fotothek df tg 0001418 Architektur ^ Geometrie ^ Perspektive ^ Schatten.jpg|thumb|Zwey Bücher: Das erste von der Ohne und durch die Arithmetica gefundenen Perspectiva, Das andere von dem dazu gehörigen Schatten. <br/>(Two books: the first of the Perspectiva ... the other of the corresponding shadow)]]

'''Andreas Albrecht''' ([[Nuremberg]] 1586 &ndash; [[Hamburg]] 1628) was a [[German people|German]] mathematician and engineer. Albrecht invented a variety of instruments, some of which are described in his treatises on architecture and perspective: ''Instrument zur Architectur'' ([[Nuremberg]], 1622); ''Eygendliche Beschreibung'' (Nuremberg, 1625); and ''Duo Libri. Prior de Perspectiva ... Posterior de umbra ...'' (Nuremberg, 1625).<ref>Fritz Schnelbögl. [https://books.google.com/books?id=Q_Q_AQAAIAAJ Beiträge zur Geschichte und Kultur der Stadt Nürnberg, Volume 10] Stadtbibliothek, 1967, p26</ref>
